title: On Happening on the same stretch of road
subtitle: 困难与应对 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 困难与应对（做人与做事·困难与应对）
meta: 主题语境：困难与应对（做人与做事·困难与应对）　|　核心词汇：happen　|　正文 352 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 happen 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1984 the accident ① happened on the same stretch of road before dawn, and every actor in the theatre said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the accident ② happens on the same stretch of road in public without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ happen on the same stretch of road at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ happened on the same stretch of road before — a line in the poster for August 1978 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Happening on the same stretch of road before dawn, the director said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the script at the far stage, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if the accident ever ⑥ happens to the same family twice in public before the August rains, nobody in the theatre would know what to do next. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: let it ⑦ happen to the same family twice in public and never speak of it again.

By 1991 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the poster, and a second accident ⑧ happens to the same family twice before dawn every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. Nobody in the theatre said a word; ⑨ The accident happened on the same stretch of road again in 1994, and this time nothing was written down.

⑩ To happen on the same stretch of road, my mother said in 1996, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the theatre remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the theatre forgets, the accident happens on the same stretch of road in public again and the accident must happen on the same stretch of road before dawn all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 发生在（一般过去式 happened on the same stretch of road：1984 年那场意外头一回这样做，天没亮就）
B. v. 发生在（一般现在 happens on the same stretch of road：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 发生在（不定式 to happen on the same stretch of road：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 发生在（过去完成时 had happened on the same stretch of road：1978 年八月的戏报上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 发生在（动名词 happening on the same stretch of road 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 落到…头上（happens to the same family twice：if 从句里的谓语，指万一真落到…头上两次落到同一家人头上）
G. v. 落到…头上（happen to the same family twice：let it 之后的原形，指随它去两次落到同一家人头上）
H. v. 发生在（后段两处：后来的那场意外照例 happens to the same family twice，而那场意外在 1994 年又一次 happened on the same stretch of road）

items.q: happened on the same stretch of road
happens on the same stretch of road
to happen on the same stretch of road
happened on the same stretch of road before
happening on the same stretch of road
happens to the same family twice in public
happen to the same family twice in public and
happens to the same family twice before dawn
happened on the same stretch of road again
to happen on the same stretch of road

answers.why: happen 意为“发生在”，1984 年那场意外天没亮就发生在在桥头那同一段路上，那是戏院里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 happened。
happen 意为“发生在”，自那以后那场意外当着众人面把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 happens。
happen 意为“发生在”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯发生在在桥头那同一段路上”，此处为不定式 to happen on the same stretch of road。
happen 意为“发生在”，戏报里 八月 那行字说明早在 1991 年之前就有人发生在过，故用过去完成时 had happened。
happen 意为“发生在”，那场意外说“发生在在桥头那同一段路上这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 happening on the same stretch of road 作主语。
happen 意为“落到…头上”，叔叔说的是“万一那场意外真落到…头上两次落到同一家人头上”，if 从句里用一般现在 happens to the same family twice。
happen 意为“落到…头上”，老手们的规矩是“随它落到…头上两次落到同一家人头上”（let it happen to the same family twice），此处用省略 to 的动词原形。
happen 意为“发生在”，后来的那场意外每个夜晚都照例落到…头上两次落到同一家人头上，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 happens。
happen 意为“发生在”，那场意外在 1994 年在无人肯做的时候又一次天没亮就发生在在桥头那同一段路上，用一般过去式 happened 叙述。
happen 意为“发生在”，结尾那句是母亲 1996 年的话：要发生在在桥头那同一段路上，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和戏院记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1984 年，那场意外天没亮就发生在在桥头那同一段路上；戏院里每一个演员都说这是头一回。（happened on the same stretch of road）
多年以后，那场意外仍当着众人面做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（happens on the same stretch of road）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯发生在在桥头那同一段路上这件事本身。（to happen on the same stretch of road）
早在 1978 年就有人发生在在桥头那同一段路上，八月那天戏报上的一行字就是证据。（had happened on the same stretch of road）
那场意外说过，天没亮就发生在在桥头那同一段路上这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（happening on the same stretch of road 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：随它落到…头上两次落到同一家人头上，以后再也不要提起。（let it happen to the same family twice）
answers: In 1984 the accident happened on the same stretch of road before dawn, and every actor in the theatre said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three nights on, the accident still happens on the same stretch of road in public without being asked.
My mother said later that to happen on the same stretch of road at all was the part nobody had expected.
The accident had happened on the same stretch of road long before 1991, and the line in the poster for August proves it.
Happening on the same stretch of road before dawn, the director said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: let it happen to the same family twice in public and never speak of it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 happen 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1984 the accident happened on the same stretch of road before dawn, and nobody in the theatre forgot it.
Even now the accident happens on the same stretch of road in public whenever the theatre asks.
Happening on the same stretch of road before dawn, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If the accident ever happens to the same family twice in public before the August rains, nobody knows what to do next.
A second accident happens to the same family twice before dawn every night, asking nothing about the past.
The accident happened on the same stretch of road again in 1994, and this time nothing was written down.
